name: gg97k9-deploy-approvals
goal: Prove that both Harness app renderers can review a pinned deployment, record an authenticated decision, and that the synthetic scripted runner rejects generic answers, stale scopes, and reused receipts.

evidence: The deploy approval feature spec defines the exact plan, verified native owner, terminal decisions and one-time scripted runner acceptance.
Native account routes, shared approval UI, owner-scoped D1 CAS, and signed broker admission are implemented. The lane remains opt-in for synthetic qualification.

Isolated harbor-mbp-2 baseline reproduction: all three viewport cases failed at the missing Deploy approvals entry. Stamped renderer passed all three with actual navigation and heap evidence. Focused checks passed 7 scripted-deploy CLI, 20 Hub API/runner and 658 Swift debug/release checks. The synthetic runner refused generic Tracker text, unsigned and mismatched authorization, plan drift and a copied receipt.
